info.name: Google Cloud Storage JSON BucketAccessControls DefaultObjectAccessControls API

description.content:
RESTful API for managing Google Cloud Storage resources including buckets and objects. Cloud Storage allows you to store and retrieve data on Google's infrastructure with high durability, availability, and scalability. The JSON API provides programmatic access to create, configure, and manage storage buckets, upload and download objects, control access permissions, and manage object metadata.
